protocol.retrieval: absent_by_design; every record carries its own context inline

grader_side_execution.note: the python_unit scorer executes MODEL-EMITTED CODE inside a sandbox after the trial has ended. This is grader-side execution, not a tool offered to the model, and it is therefore not part of the model-visible tool protocol.

tool_steps_feature.meaning: size_features.tool_steps is a difficulty estimate of how many tool steps a solver would need, not a count of tools actually offered
tool_steps_feature.non_zero_note: tool_selection asks the model to emit a JSON plan about tools; it still calls no tool. tool_selection is an auxiliary family and is not part of the EVAL-131 required coverage.

forbidden_action_rule: the EVAL-131 integrity clause (zero forbidden/unauthorised tool actions) is satisfied vacuously for this freeze because no tool surface is exposed. Any future freeze that exposes tools must mint a new tool protocol id and re-state the rule non-vacuously.
binding: CapabilityProfile.tool_protocol and every counted observation must carry g13-tool-protocol-v1-no-model-visible-tools
change_policy: exposing any tool to the model is breaking: mint a new tool protocol id and a new pool freeze version
